description: This file declares functions and structures related to Python tracing within the Torch JIT compiler, including tracer initialization, source range retrieval, and graph creation functions triggered by Python code.

methods.name: initPythonTracerBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python tracer bindings in a given Python module.

methods.name: getPythonInterpreterSourceRange
methods.description: Retrieves source range information of the Python interpreter.

methods.name: preRecordPythonTrace
methods.description: Begins recording a Python trace for a given Python object and input types.

methods.name: createGraphByTracingWithDict
methods.description: Creates a computational graph by tracing a Python function with a dictionary of inputs.

methods.name: createGraphByTracing
methods.description: Creates a computational graph by tracing a Python function with provided input stack.
